Waterfall ravine.notes: Scramble crossing of a waterfall ravine around 4,000 ft. A higher line along the rock face is the more exposed choice and may call for a rope; a lower line on the climber's left is less exposed. Early-season snow and ice can make the crossing slick. Above it the forest opens out to views of Wing Peak.
